newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein off to Jericho with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein off to Jericho with Arafat.

text.p: King Hussein and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat took off on Tuesday by helicopter on the monarch's first visit to the West Bank in 29 years, a palace source said.

The source told Reuters the two leaders left in a Jordanian military helicopter from the Hashimiyah palace. It will the king's first visit to the West Bank since Jordan lost the territory to Israel in the 1967 Middle East war.
King Hussein, Israel's closest Arab ally since Jordan signed a peace treaty in 1994, has stepped up public support of Arafat in recent days while distancing himself from Netanyahu.

Palestinian spokesman Nabil Abu Rudainah said the king's visit to self-ruled Jericho after a visit by Arafat to Amman would boost the Palestinians in talks to get Israel to honour signed peace accords.

"We welcome the visit of His Majesty. We consider it the first visit of an Arab head of state that will back the Palestinian negotiator and consolidate Palestinian sovereignty over Palestinian land," Abu Rudainah told Reuters.

Negotiators and diplomats worked in Jerusalem and Amman late on Monday to break an impasse over the long-delayed Hebron pullback. The fate of formal U.S.-brokered talks slated for Tuesday in Egypt's Red Sea resort of Taba remained unclear.
